nombre_oficial: el glosario pide "Toltec" para "Tolteca / Toltecas" y no aparece

frase_gancho.texto: After the city of the gods comes the city of the warriors.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: When Teotihuacán faded, the valley filled with cities that wanted to take its place. This hall begins in those centuries of upheaval, between the years seven hundred and nine hundred, with traces of places like Xochicalco, Cacaxtla and Teotenango, and arrives at Tula, the capital of the Toltecs, who dominated central Mexico until around eleven fifty. For the Mexica, the Toltecs were the wise men and artists par excellence: the word “Toltec” came to mean artisan. Here you will see giant warriors who held up a roof, a wall of serpents, animals that march like an army, and the legend of a priest-king, Quetzalcóatl, who lost his city and became a star.
